records.title: analysis: reframe discriminator guidance for assertion-shaped owners
records.release_claim: focused repair guidance remains coherent when the changed owner is itself an assertion/oracle helper
records.reason: The old guidance could recommend testing the oracle itself or replacing an intentional invariant with an inapplicable equality assertion.
records.non_claim: Owner-shape evidence reframes guidance and does not promote exposure class or repair readiness.

records.title: perf(analysis): cap the repo-scoped working set like the diff path
records.release_claim: deep and ready repo analysis fail closed before unbounded workspace indexing
records.reason: The old repo path could exhaust memory without a named stop reason or bounded continuation.
records.non_claim: The default cap is an operational bound, not evidence that the uninspected repository is clean.

records.title: perf(analysis): stat-only corpus fingerprint for the seam cache key
records.release_claim: warm repository analysis avoids rereading every Rust file while preserving the exact content-hash cache identity
records.reason: The measured warm path remained tens of seconds without this layer; its stale-key review finding was fixed with Unix ctime and a schema bump.
records.non_claim: Non-Unix fingerprint residuals remain documented and every mapping failure is a cache miss.

records.title: test(analysis): cover fingerprint cache-key reconstruction
records.release_claim: the stat-only mapping reconstructs the same content-based key and fails closed on a missing mapping
records.reason: This is direct parity evidence required by the included cache acceleration.
records.non_claim: The test does not broaden cache authority beyond the production contract.

records.title: feat(doctor): probe verify-route runtimes for detected languages
records.release_claim: doctor names missing runtimes required by the recommended verification route without executing repository-controlled tooling unsafely
records.reason: Multi-language repair guidance is not usable when required runtimes are discovered only after delegation; the review also isolated Yarn probing from checkout-controlled configuration.
records.non_claim: Runtime availability remains advisory and does not change static analysis or language support tier.

records.title: ux(cli): report missing scope before the JSON requirement in agent subcommands
records.release_claim: agent commands report the fundamental missing identity or scope before format ceremony
records.reason: Useful first-use correction, but independently deferrable if help and known-limit copy describe the old ordering honestly.
records.non_claim: Validation order does not change artifact, scope, or command authority.
